description: This file contains implementation of big number arithmetic functions such as multiplication, squaring, division, and addition for large integers, used in cryptographic operations within the BN (Big Number) library.

methods.name: bn_mul_add_words
methods.description: Multiplies and adds words in big number multiplication, optimized for different architectures.

methods.name: bn_mul_words
methods.description: Performs multiplication of big number words.

methods.name: bn_div_words
methods.description: Divides two words by a divisor, returning the quotient.

methods.name: bn_add_words
methods.description: Adds two big number words with carry handling.
